title.ru: Зеркало Реестра Януса — реверсный закон принадлежности
title.en: Janus Roster Mirror — Reverse Admission Law

method.name: JANUS_REVERSE_MIRROR_PASS
method.rule: Do not ask first why a candidate looks plausible. Start from the strongest claimed roster status and walk backward until the first necessary binding is unsupported.
method.claim_boundary: The mirror extracts a shared epistemic structure from four registry artifacts. It does not claim that the four source domains are otherwise equivalent.

source_artifacts.source_fact: A script enum-only candidate is retained without promotion because runtime clue-provider use is not established.
source_artifacts.reverse_question: If RUNTIME_MEMBER is claimed, where is the shipped runtime-use evidence that binds this enum identity to the provider roster?

source_artifacts.source_fact: Martial-arts, dance, acrobatics, or general flexibility alone are explicitly insufficient; direct visual evidence, direct self-report, or a reliable explicit source is required.
source_artifacts.reverse_question: If CONFIRMED_SKILL is claimed, what direct or explicit evidence demonstrates the exact skill rather than a neighboring background?

source_artifacts.source_fact: A18 distinguishes fresh, grace, stale, and missing; a known swarm node may remain known while current roster telemetry is absent.
source_artifacts.reverse_question: If FRESH_NODE is claimed, what recent observation within the freshness window proves current presence rather than historical identity?

source_artifacts.source_fact: A broad compiled rescue candidate does not decrement the authoritative prior tail unless the actor is source-bound as a member of that prior population.
source_artifacts.reverse_question: If membership in a historical authoritative roster is claimed, what provenance binds the candidate identity to that exact prior population?

forward_convergence.interpretation_ru: Во всех четырёх доменах слабый признак может породить кандидата, но не имеет права сам повысить его до сильного статуса.

mirror_convergence.canonical_reverse_law: CLAIMED_ROSTER_STATUS -> IDENTITY_BOUND + ROLE_BOUND + EVIDENCE_BOUND + AUTHORITY_BOUND + TIME_BOUND_WHEN_DYNAMIC
mirror_convergence.logical_note: The arrow expresses necessary evidence obligations, not automatic sufficiency. Satisfying one binding never waives the others.
mirror_convergence.compressed_ru: Сильный статус обязан нести доказательство собственного происхождения.
mirror_convergence.compressed_en: A strong status must carry the proof of how it became strong.

coordinates.entity: WHO exactly is being classified; identity must be bound.
coordinates.role: WHAT exact membership, capability, or operational role is claimed.
coordinates.authority_scope: WHICH roster, source population, runtime, registry, or governing evidence set defines membership.
coordinates.time_scope: WHEN the claim is valid; mandatory for dynamic liveness and useful for versioned historical rosters.
coordinates.evidence_scope: WHY the status is admitted; exact evidence and gate history.

five_coordinate_roster_model.discovery: Membership is not an intrinsic one-bit property of an entity. It is a scoped relation.

gates_in_reverse_order.question: What exact strong status is being asserted?
Is the status current, historical, or timeless, and is the required time evidence present?
Which authoritative roster/source/snapshot defines the membership?
Does the evidence demonstrate this exact role/status rather than an adjacent trait or proxy?
Is the observed/candidate identity bound to the claimed entity?
What generated the candidate in the first place?

reverse_gate_engine.stop_rule: Stop at the earliest necessary unsupported binding and demote the claim to the strongest status actually justified.
reverse_gate_engine.forbidden_move: Never backfill a missing gate with plausibility from a different coordinate.

new_findings_from_reverse_pass.detail: A roster entry only has meaning relative to role, authority, time, evidence, and bound identity.
When a gate fails, the entity should fall back to candidate/known/stale/unbound rather than be erased. Failure of a stronger status does not prove absence.
Not proving membership is not proof of non-membership; not fresh is not never known; not confirmed skill is not inability.
Swarm exposes what static rosters hide: a once-valid admission can remain historically true while becoming operationally stale.
F3DAD exposes that even strong new evidence cannot rewrite a prior authoritative population unless identity is linked into that exact population.
All-Star shows that neighboring traits may generate candidates but cannot substitute for evidence of the exact predicate being claimed.
MS08 shows that being encoded or enumerated in a system can be weaker than participating in the shipped/runtime behavior.

connection_to_tporh.note: The same mirror law generalizes defensively to unsolicited external signals: receipt/presence can create an event candidate, but affiliation or control requires separate identity, acceptance, relationship, authority/context, and time bindings.
connection_to_tporh.safe_boundary: This crosslink is defensive provenance logic only and contains no targeting, deceptive-transfer, or entrapment procedure.

claim_boundaries: This artifact derives an epistemic roster model from the cited Janus registry artifacts.
It does not assert that game data, human skill evidence, swarm telemetry, and historical forensic populations are substantively equivalent.
The reverse law supplies necessary admission checks; domain-specific sufficiency rules remain authoritative.
Unknown, unproven, stale, and false are distinct states and must not be collapsed.

ru: Roster — это не список. Это доказуемое отношение.
Присутствие порождает кандидата, а не принадлежность.
Сильный статус обязан нести доказательство собственного происхождения.
Устарело — не значит никогда не существовало.
Чем сильнее статус, тем длиннее его обратный путь к доказательству.
en: A roster is not a list. It is a provable relation.
Presence generates a candidate, not membership.
A strong status must carry the proof of how it became strong.
The stronger the status, the longer its reverse path to evidence.
